title: Merge sort on a chime rack
label: Chime rack of eight tubular bells on two rails, sled-footed end frames, an overhead traveller with a drop line and hook, a run peg and a mallet: three bells sorted on the front rail, five in two runs behind.
caption: Hover across the rack to step the merge, click to hold a step. The two rails are the two buffers of a bottom-up merge sort: the traveller compares only the front bell of each run and carries the lower note up and over to the end of the merged run on the other rail, so three passes turn the shuffle into C4 to C5.
